headline: Maui Civil Service Commission

meeting.summary: The Civil Service Commission approved a reference questionnaire and candidate letter topics and set September 30 interviews for a new personnel director.
meeting.recap: The commission reviewed its plan for hiring a new Department of Personnel Services director.[[0:02:01]] Commissioners agreed that references should send answers directly to the commission, not through the candidate.[[0:38:45]] The commission approved a professional reference questionnaire cut to nine questions.[[0:40:55]] A commissioner moved to set the topics for a letter to candidates, including required in-person interviews.[[1:14:09]] The commission approved the letter topics.[[1:19:25]] The commission approved the leader's intent statement as drafted.[[1:19:58]] Legal advice on interview questions can be discussed in executive session (a closed-door meeting).[[1:29:04]] Candidates must send their list of references by September 4.[[1:41:55]] Leader's intent responses and reference questionnaire answers are due September 18.[[1:41:59]] Interviews are set for September 30.[[1:42:05]] October 7 is listed as the selection date.[[1:42:09]] A stakeholder meeting was set for September 16 from 1 to 4.[[1:54:05]] The September 2 meeting will be extended until 3 p.m. for an executive session.[[1:56:35]] Commissioners said the pick will be made by majority vote and need not be unanimous.[[2:04:04]] The commission authorized a commissioner to draft and send the stakeholder email.[[2:28:03]] The commission voted to send a letter thanking a staff member for her support.[[2:29:32]]
decided: The commission approved the professional reference questionnaire with the changes made at the meeting.
The commission approved the list of topics for the candidate cover letter.
The commission approved the leader's intent statement as drafted.
The commission authorized a commissioner to write the stakeholder email and send it with help from county lawyers and the personnel department.
The commission approved a letter on its behalf thanking a staff member for her support.
meeting.next: A commissioner will help draft the candidate cover letter. Reference questionnaires will go out as candidates send in their reference lists. Staff will check with other departments on how post-offer background checks are done.
